An incomplete fragment from a Samian ware vessel of Roman date. Part of the foot and base of the vessel are preserved, the remainder missing due to old breaks. This is the base from a Central Gaulish/Lezoux (SACG) Samian cup, probably of Dragendorff form DR 33.
